cleanTitle: Ezekiel 37 Valley of Dry Bones Awakening of Gods People remove yourselves from man made religions!
segments: And when I beheld, lo, the senus, and
the flesh came up upon them, and the
skin covered them above, but there was
no breath in them. There's no breath, no
life in Islam, no breath, no life in
Christianity. No breath, no life in any
of these man-made religions. There's no
breath. There's no life there. And when
it TALKS ABOUT LIFE, ETERNAL LIFE,
rulership reigning on the earth is what
in these religions are not going to get
it. I don't care how how many humbilly
and how many Hail Marys they do.
It means nothing to the one true God,
the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
